lvgl.compile_s_hello_note: full library from source (483 TUs, -Os) compiled with 3 parallel jobs plus link, best of 3
lvgl.hello_includes: LVGL core + widgets + default theme + Montserrat 14 + software renderer, RAM framebuffer display with no-op flush, no window system; linked with --gc-sections, clib stdlib
lvgl.frame_includes: full software render (lv_timer_handler with the screen invalidated every frame, 960x640 XRGB8888 RAM framebuffer, flush callback is a no-op); retained-mode widgets built once, so no per-frame widget submission; rows past 640px are clipped by the renderer
lvgl.real_includes: LVGL + its lv_sdl_window driver (SDL2 software renderer), SDL2 linked dynamically and not counted
notes: LVGL is retained-mode: the 50 rows are created once, per frame cost is invalidate + layout check + full software redraw of the invalidated screen
slider range is integer 0..100 (LVGL sliders are int based)
LV_USE_OS none, LV_USE_STDLIB clib, LV_COLOR_FORMAT_DEFAULT XRGB8888, default theme, Montserrat 14 font
dash rows are flex rows in a scrollable screen, only the first rows fit inside 640px, the rest are clipped
real window uses LVGL's SDL driver with SDL's software renderer

raygui.raylib_audio_module: disabled (USE_AUDIO=OFF), raylib built MinSizeRel -Os, GLFW vendored
raygui.core_lines_note: raygui.h only; raylib itself is 59339 lines (src/*.c,h + platforms)
raygui.hello_includes: raygui + raylib core built with PLATFORM_MEMORY (rlsw software rasterizer, memory framebuffer, no window system, no GPU), built-in font
raygui.frame_memory_includes: raylib PLATFORM_MEMORY: full rlsw software rasterization of 960x640 plus framebuffer copy to RAM per frame

egui.core_lines_note: rust lines in crates egui, epaint, emath, ecolor src
egui.compile_s_hello_note: clean cargo build --release of hello_null including egui and all dependencies (registry sources already fetched), best of 3
egui.hello_includes: egui + epaint + emath, default fonts and font atlas build, Context::run_ui + tessellate, no renderer and no window; opt-level=s, lto, strip
egui.frame_includes: ui build + layout + tessellation into triangle meshes (Context::run_ui then tessellate, 960x640, 1.0 ppp), no rasterization or GPU upload; immediate mode, all 50 rows built every frame, rows beyond 640px still laid out and tessellated
egui.real_includes: eframe 0.37 with glow backend (winit + glutin + egui_glow), static, GL libs dynamic and not counted; opt-level=s, lto, strip
notes: egui frame cost excludes rasterization: it stops at tessellated meshes, a GPU or software rasterizer would add to it
headless frame loop uses egui::Context::run_ui with a 960x640 RawInput and no window
slider is 0.0..=1.0 with a drag value box
real window runs under Mesa llvmpipe on Linux and Windows (mesa-dist-win), native OpenGL on macOS
